title: Cokret Account Data Self-Management Operation DTOs
description: Closed request/response DTOs for the self-surface actor-private account_data operations (ck.self.account_data.*). PUT builds a ck.account_data.set actor-private write; the server stores content verbatim (clients own canonical encoding and, for sensitive keys, client-side encryption). data_type keys are dot-delimited namespaces validated against account-data-type-registry.json. See spec/v1/zh/discovery/client-preferences.md.

data_type.description: Dot-delimited account_data namespace key (e.g. ck.contacts.realm.<realm_id>, ck.account.blocklist). Control chars / whitespace / path separators are forbidden so the key is URL- and log-safe.

content.description: Caller-supplied opaque payload, stored verbatim. Any JSON value.
Caller-supplied opaque payload. Server stores it verbatim; canonical encoding and (for sensitive keys) client-side encryption are the client's responsibility. Any JSON value.
